name: Longmen Grottoes
description: Carved into limestone cliffs along the Yi River, about 12 kilometres south of Luoyang in Henan province, the Longmen Grottoes hold roughly 2,345 caves and as many as 100,000 Buddhist statues. Some are barely an inch tall, while the largest Buddha rises 17 metres. Work began in 493 AD, and emperors and nobles kept commissioning figures for centuries, many of them in the Tang dynasty.
